items.stem: Why should a team baseline a process before trying to improve it?

options.text: Without a baseline you cannot tell whether a change actually helped
options.rationale: Correct: a measured baseline makes improvement verifiable.

options.text: Baselining guarantees the process will improve
options.rationale: It enables evaluation but does not itself cause improvement.

options.text: Baselining replaces the need for root-cause analysis
options.rationale: Measurement and root-cause analysis are complementary.
Time, cost and quality are all measurable.

items.explanation: Correct: a measured baseline makes improvement verifiable.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which actions address root causes rather than symptoms? (Select TWO)

options.text: Using 5 Whys to trace a recurring defect to its origin
options.rationale: Correct: 5 Whys drills past symptoms to the underlying cause.

options.text: Removing the bottleneck that creates a queue
options.rationale: Correct: fixing the constraint addresses the real cause of delay.

options.text: Adding more staff to clear a backlog created by rework
options.rationale: This treats the symptom while the rework cause remains.

options.text: Automating a step that should not exist at all
options.rationale: Automating waste entrenches it rather than removing it.

items.explanation: Correct: 5 Whys drills past symptoms to the underlying cause.

items.stem: A manager wants to automate a process that is full of unnecessary steps. What is the recommended sequence?

options.text: Remove the waste and fix the process first, then consider automation
options.rationale: Correct: automating a flawed process just makes the flaws faster.

options.text: Automate immediately to lock in current practice
options.rationale: This cements the waste into the automated system.
Automation is valuable once the process is sound.
Adding steps increases, not reduces, waste.

items.explanation: Correct: automating a flawed process just makes the flaws faster.
